issuer: the Federal or Regional Transport institution (the licensing body)
note: Read 2026-10-30 in the Federal Negarit Gazette's own scans as metaappz.com hosts them (the House of Peoples' Representatives, which publishes the Gazette, answered at hopr.gov.et, where the Gazette wasn't looked for further; the Federal Transport Authority's fta.gov.et didn't answer; the Ministry of Transport's mot.gov.et answered with no licence page found): Proclamation No. 1074/2018 (Negarit Gazette No. 27, 14 February 2018) and Council of Ministers Regulation No. 450/2019 (No. 59, 25 April 2019), which repealed Regulation 262/2012. An automobile licence needs the applicant to be not less than 18 (art. 8(1)); a licence issued for the first time is a temporary one, valid two years (art. 15(1)-(2)), and its promotion to a permanent licence turns on the traffic offences and accidents of those two years (art. 15(3)). The full licence is the permanent one, so its age is built from the stages: 18 plus the two temporary years, 20 (a reading: the promotion isn't automatic). A permanent licence lasts four years (art. 19(1); every two years past 55, not held). Fee: 680 birr for 'issuance of new driver's qualification certification license (for all categories)' (Regulation 450/2019, schedule item 1); renewal or replacement 620 (not held). No later fee regulation was found; whether 680 is charged at the temporary licence's issue only or again at its promotion the schedule doesn't say.

sources.title: Proclamation No. 1074/2018, Driver's Qualification Certification License Proclamation (Federal Negarit Gazette No. 27, 14 February 2018)
sources.said: Proclamation No.1074/2018 ... “Licensing Body” means The Federal or Regional Transport institution or any government institution established in accordance with law and gets delegation from the Authority to issue driver’s qualification certification license ... attained the age of not less than 18 years; ... temporary driving qualification certification license ... be two years. ... shall be determined by number of record of traffic offence and accident ... valid for a period of four years from the date of its issuance
